chapterInfo.content:
2
Wɔn a wɔsane baeɛ no dodoɔ
1 # Neh 7.5-73 Na yeinom ne asase no sofoɔ a wɔfiri nnommum a Babelhene Nebukadnessar tuu wɔn kɔɔ Babel nkoayɛ mu no sane baeɛ na wɔsane kɔtenaa Yerusalem ne Yuda nkuro mu. 2#Esra 1.8; 2.63 Wɔne Serubabel na ɛbaeɛ. Wɔn ne: Yesua, Nehemia, Seraia, Reelaia, Mordekai, Bilsan, Mispar, Bigwai, Rehum, Baana.
Israel man mu mmarima dodoɔ nie: 3Paros mma: Mpennu ɔha aduɔson mmienu. 4Sefatia mma: Ahasa aduɔson mmienu. 5Arah mma: Ahanson aduɔson nnum. 6Pahat-Moab mma: Yesua ne Yoab mma deɛ: Mpennu ahanwɔtwe ne dummienu. 7Elam mma: Apem ahanu aduonum nnan. 8Satu mma: Ahankron aduanan nnum. 9Sakai mma: Ahanson aduosia. 10Bani mma: Ahansia aduanan mmienu. 11Bebai mma: Ahansia aduonu mmiɛnsa. 12Asgad mma: Apem ahanu aduonu mmienu. 13Adonikam mma: Ahansia aduosia nsia. 14Bigwai mma: Mpennu aduonum nsia. 15Adin mma: Ahanan aduonum nnan. 16Ater mma: Hesekia deɛ, aduɔkron nwɔtwe. 17Besai mma: Ahasa aduonu mmiɛnsa. 18Yora mma: Ɔha ne dummienu. 19Hasum mma: Ahanu aduonu mmiɛnsa. 20Gibar mma: Aduɔkron nnum. 21Betlehem mma: Ɔha aduonu mmiɛnsa. 22Netofa mmarima: Aduonum nsia. 23Anatot mmarima: Ɔha aduonu nwɔtwe. 24Asmawet mma: Aduanan mmienu. 25Kiriat-arim, Kefira ne Beerot mma: Ahanson aduanan mmiɛnsa. 26Rama ne Geba mma: Ahansia aduonu baako. 27Mikmas mmarima: Ɔha aduonu mmienu. 28Betel ne Ai mmarima: Ahanu aduonu mmiɛnsa. 29Nebo mma: Aduonum mmienu. 30Magbis mma: Ɔha aduonum nsia. 31Elam foforɔ bi mma: Apem ahanu aduonum nnan. 32Harim mma: Ahasa aduonu. 33Lod, Hadid ne Ono mma: Ahanson aduonu nnum. 34Yeriko mma: Ahasa aduanan nnum. 35Senaa mma: Mpensa ahansia aduasa.
36Asɔfoɔ no: Yedaia mma: Yesua fie deɛ: Ahankron aduɔson mmiɛnsa. 37Imer mma: Apem aduonum mmienu. 38Pasur mma: Apem ahanu aduanan nson. 39Harim mma: Apem ne dunson.
40 # Neh 12.8 Lewifoɔ: Yesua ne Kadmiel mma: Hodawia mma deɛ: Aduɔson nnan.
41Nnwontofoɔ: Asaf mma: Ɔha aduonu nwɔtwe.
42Apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no mma: Salum mma, Ater mma, Talmon mma, Akub mma, Hatita mma, Sobai mma: Wɔn nyinaa yɛ ɔha aduasa nkron.
43 # Esra 8.20 Nsɔfokwaa: Siha mma, Hasufa mma, Tabaot mma, 44Keros mma, Siaha mma, Padon mma, 45Lebana mma, Hagaba mma, Akub mma, 46Hagab mma, Samlai mma, Hanan mma, 47Gidel mma, Gahar mma, Reaia mma, 48Resin mma, Nekoda mma, Gasam mma, 49Usa mma, Pasea mma, Besai mma, 50Asna mma, Meunifoɔ mma, Nefisifoɔ mma, 51Bakbuk mma, Hakufa mma, Harhur mma, 52Baslut mma, Mehida mma, Harsa mma, 53Barkos mma, Sisera mma, Tama mma, 54Nesia mma, Hatifa mma.
55 # 1 Ah 9.21 Salomo nkoa mma: Sotai mma, Hasoferet mma, Peruda mma, 56Yaala mma, Darkon mma, Gidel mma, 57Sefatia mma, Hatil mma, Pokeret-hasebaim mma, Ami mma.
58 # Yos 9.23 Nsɔfokwaa nyinaa ne Salomo nkoa mma: Ahasa aduɔkron mmienu.
59Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔfiri Tel-mela, Tel-harsa, Kerub, Adan ne Imer foro baeɛ, na wɔantumi ankyerɛ wɔn mpanimfie ne wɔn ase, sɛ wɔfiri Israel mu anaa. 60Delaia mma, Tobia mma, Nekoda mma: Ahansia aduonum mmienu. 61#2 Sa 19.31 Na asɔfoɔ mma mu: Habaia mma, Hakos mma, Barsilai (a ɔwaree Gileadni Barsilai mma mu baako na wɔde wɔn din too no mma): 62Yeinom hwehwɛɛ wɔn din wɔ mmusua ntwerɛeɛ mu, na wɔanhunu, na wɔbuu wɔn sɛ wɔn ho nteɛ nti, wɔyii wɔn firii asɔfodie mu. 63#Esra 2.2; Eks 28.30 Na amrado ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnni akronkronneɛ mu adekronkron no bi kɔsi sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ bi de Urim ne Tumim bɛkyerɛ wɔn gyinabea.
64Badwa mu no nyinaa ano si mpem aduanan mmienu ne ahasa aduosia, 65ɛsono wɔn nkoa ne wɔn mfenaa, wɔn nso yɛ mpemnson ahasa aduasa nson. Na wɔwɔ nnwontofoɔ mmarima ne mmaa ahanu. 66Wɔn apɔnkɔ yɛ ahanson aduasa nsia, wɔn mfunumupɔnkɔ, ahanu aduanan nnum, 67wɔn yoma: Ahanan aduasa nnum; mfunumu, mpemnsia ahanson aduonu.
68Na agyanom atitire no mu binom baa AWURADE fie a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no, wɔbɛkyekyɛɛ Nyankopɔn fie no ho ayamyi adeɛ, sɛ wɔmfa mma so nsi ne sibea. 69Deɛ wɔbɛtumi na wɔde guu adwuma no ho akoradeɛ mu, sika nsuruboaa mpem aduosia baako ne dwetɛ mmɛnaa mpemnum ne asɔfoɔ ntadeɛ ɔha.
70Asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ no ne ɔman no mu binom ne nnwontofoɔ no ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no ne nsɔfokwaa no bɛtenatenaa wɔn nkuro mu, na Israel nyinaa tenatenaa wɔn nkuro mu.

Israel man mu mmarima dodoɔ nie: Paros mma: Mpennu ɔha aduɔson mmienu. Sefatia mma: Ahasa aduɔson mmienu. Arah mma: Ahanson aduɔson nnum. Bebai mma: Ahansia aduonu mmiɛnsa. Asgad mma: Apem ahanu aduonu mmienu. Adonikam mma: Ahansia aduosia nsia. Bigwai mma: Mpennu aduonum nsia. Adin mma: Ahanan aduonum nnan. Harim mma: Ahasa aduonu. Lod, Hadid ne Ono mma: Ahanson aduonu nnum. Yeriko mma: Ahasa aduanan nnum. Senaa mma: Mpensa ahansia aduasa.
Asɔfoɔ no: Yedaia mma: Yesua fie deɛ: Ahankron aduɔson mmiɛnsa. Imer mma: Apem aduonum mmienu. Pasur mma: Apem ahanu aduanan nson. Harim mma: Apem ne dunson.
Lewifoɔ: Yesua ne Kadmiel mma: Hodawia mma deɛ: Aduɔson nnan.
Nnwontofoɔ: Asaf mma: Ɔha aduonu nwɔtwe.
Apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no mma: Salum mma, Ater mma, Talmon mma, Akub mma, Hatita mma, Sobai mma: Wɔn nyinaa yɛ ɔha aduasa nkron.
Nsɔfokwaa: Siha mma, Hasufa mma, Tabaot mma, Keros mma, Siaha mma, Padon mma, Lebana mma, Hagaba mma, Akub mma, Hagab mma, Samlai mma, Hanan mma, Gidel mma, Gahar mma, Reaia mma, Resin mma, Nekoda mma, Gasam mma, Usa mma, Pasea mma, Besai mma, Asna mma, Meunifoɔ mma, Nefisifoɔ mma, Bakbuk mma, Hakufa mma, Harhur mma, Baslut mma, Mehida mma, Harsa mma, Barkos mma, Sisera mma, Tama mma, Nesia mma, Hatifa mma.
Salomo nkoa mma: Sotai mma, Hasoferet mma, Peruda mma, Yaala mma, Darkon mma, Gidel mma, Sefatia mma, Hatil mma, Pokeret-hasebaim mma, Ami mma.
Nsɔfokwaa nyinaa ne Salomo nkoa mma: Ahasa aduɔkron mmienu.
Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔfiri Tel-mela, Tel-harsa, Kerub, Adan ne Imer foro baeɛ, na wɔantumi ankyerɛ wɔn mpanimfie ne wɔn ase, sɛ wɔfiri Israel mu anaa. Delaia mma, Tobia mma, Nekoda mma: Ahansia aduonum mmienu. Badwa mu no nyinaa ano si mpem aduanan mmienu ne ahasa aduosia, ɛsono wɔn nkoa ne wɔn mfenaa, wɔn nso yɛ mpemnson ahasa aduasa nson. Na wɔwɔ nnwontofoɔ mmarima ne mmaa ahanu. Wɔn apɔnkɔ yɛ ahanson aduasa nsia, wɔn mfunumupɔnkɔ, ahanu aduanan nnum, wɔn yoma: Ahanan aduasa nnum; mfunumu, mpemnsia ahanson aduonu.
Na agyanom atitire no mu binom baa AWURADE fie a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no, wɔbɛkyekyɛɛ Nyankopɔn fie no ho ayamyi adeɛ, sɛ wɔmfa mma so nsi ne sibea. Deɛ wɔbɛtumi na wɔde guu adwuma no ho akoradeɛ mu, sika nsuruboaa mpem aduosia baako ne dwetɛ mmɛnaa mpemnum ne asɔfoɔ ntadeɛ ɔha.
Asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ no ne ɔman no mu binom ne nnwontofoɔ no ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no ne nsɔfokwaa no bɛtenatenaa wɔn nkuro mu, na Israel nyinaa tenatenaa wɔn nkuro mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
